SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

6. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

11. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

15. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   B. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   D. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
